cohort: 20 pregnant women at the Sylvanus Olympio University Hospital Center in Lome, Togo, who underwent epidural analgesia (out of 29 selected) with an average age of 30.6 years, 35% primiparas, 50% multiparas, and 25% obese (BMI>30).
finding: Epidural analgesia was successfully administered to 20 parturients, with a high level of satisfaction (9.8/10) and low rates of complications such as hypotension (5%) and cesarean section (5%).
mod_finding: Vaginal births accounted for 95% of deliveries, while cesarean section accounted for 5%.
